newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Macau says cargo, passenger growth strong.
newsitem.headline: Macau says cargo, passenger growth strong.

text.p: Macau International Airport Company (CAM) recorded its second highest cargo tonnage total in March since opening in November 1995, an airport spokesman told Reuters.

He said 3,736 tonnes of cargo passed through the Portuguese enclave's airport bringing the total so far this year to 8,522 tonnes. During all of 1996, Macau recorded 25,046 tonnes of cargo with November setting the monthly record of 4,417 tonnes.
"It has been another very good month for us and we are very, very pleased," the spokesman added.
The March passenger figure reached 149,765, also the second highest total since the airport opened, just behind February's record total of 150,772 passengers.
The figures are expected to further rise after the introduction of some 50 new flights this month as part of airlines' summer schedules. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +5017
